validation.description: Test event hook system under high concurrency conditions
requirements: Should handle multiple hooks being registered simultaneously
Should handle multiple events being triggered simultaneously
Should maintain correct order of event processing
Should prevent race conditions in hook execution
Should handle hooks being added/removed while events are being processed

concurrency_scenarios.description: Many hooks registered for a single event type
concurrency_scenarios.expected_behavior: All hooks should be called in registration order

concurrency_scenarios.description: One hook registered for many event types
concurrency_scenarios.expected_behavior: Hook should be called for each matching event

concurrency_scenarios.description: Hooks being registered and unregistered during event processing
concurrency_scenarios.expected_behavior: System should maintain consistency and prevent partial updates
System should prevent infinite recursion and handle event chains properly
